candidate.title: Fixed an issue where controller-assigned IPs did not respect per-proxy DNS capture the same way that ephemeral auto-allocated IPs did

evidence.excerpt:
- |
    **Fixed** an issue where controller-assigned IPs did not respect per-proxy DNS capture the same way that ephemeral auto-allocated IPs did.

issue: auto ip controller doesn't respect dns capture [closed; labels kind/bug]
Presently addresses assigned by the new IP autoassign controller are treated internally as though a user assigned them which means they are used by proxies even if the proxy isn't using dns capture. previously there was a distinction allowed which should be respected by the new controller method.
